description.content:
A collection of short, sharp documentaries exploring the history of Linux, free software, and open source philosophy. From the birth of distributions to the battles for digital freedom, these videos dive into the key moments that shaped the world of tech as we know it.

No fluff, just facts — told with a voice that doesn't fear strong opinions.
